style: flat vector cartoon game art, soft inner glow, clean silhouette, bold flat shapes, cool indigo and cyan space palette
notes: One art style for the whole project, repeated word for word at the head of every prompt (rule F.1c). Every sprite declares its orientation in words (rule C.8): all but one are radially or bilaterally symmetric and say so, so the code never mirrors them; sprite_icon_back is the only asymmetric piece and is drawn as a chevron facing LEFT, which is exactly how it is used and never flipped. Sprites are drawn over whatever backdrop the model picks and matted out by the pipeline (rule F.1b), so no prompt argues about background colour. Nothing in this set carries a 9-slice border: every piece is square content drawn at a square size, and the UI chrome reuses the template's own sliced_solid_round plate. There is no coin or currency art: the only numbers this game shows are routes, streak and accuracy. No sprite contains a letter, a word or a logo.
